items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after a meal is linked to a smaller rise in sugar, especially after dinner. Try walking 10 to 19 minutes after dinner to get most of the gain.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: Eating dinner at 8 pm or later is linked to a bigger rise in sugar. Try to start dinner before 8 pm to see if it makes a difference.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Your overnight fast averaged 10.3 hours, and 0.0% of nights reached 13 hours. In the randomized program, adding the overnight fast to coaching changed HbA1c by -0.03 points (95% CI -0.06 to 0.0) compared with coaching alone. It looked larger in some blood sugar groups, but the program could not tell the groups apart, so this is the overall number. A check in real people (NHANES) showed no clear link yet.

rejected.text: Fasting overnight for 10 to 13 hours may be helpful. You averaged 10.3 hours of overnight fasting, and it's worth trying to reach 13 hours to see how your body responds.
